emotional_tone: Luxury, Premium, Minimal, Elegant, Future-Ready, Technology Driven

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Editorial Future' mixed with 'Swiss Brutalist' precision. 'Cabinet Grotesk' provides a bold, wide, premium feel for headings. 'Satoshi' offers flawless geometric clarity for long-form reading. 'JetBrains Mono' is used exclusively for badges, labels, and tech specs.

neumorphism.rule: Only use for interactive LMS widgets, never globally.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke mandatory for glass surfaces. Light: border-black/5, Dark: border-white/10

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), solid contrast color, magnetic hover effect. Light mode: bg-black text-white hover:scale-105 transition-transform. Dark mode: bg-white text-black hover:scale-105.
buttons.secondary: Glass-morphism pill with 1px border, backdrop blur, transparent background. Hover adds subtle glow.
buttons.magnetic: Use Framer Motion to map mouse position to transform values for magnetic stickiness.

cards_course.layout: Grid-based or flex column. Image top (max-h-48, object-cover).
cards_course.style: Glass card, subtle 1px border. Hover: slightly lifts (-translate-y-2), shadow increases, image slightly scales up (scale-105).
cards_course.content: Title (h4), Instructor (text-sm), Rating, Level Badge (mono font), Price, Hover Reveal 'Enroll' CTA.

cards_service.layout: Interactive expanding panels (Accordion style or flex-grow on hover).
cards_service.style: Dark mode: #0A1122 background, glowing border tracing effect (Aceternity style).

component_styling.badges: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider bg-accent/10 text-accent border border-accent/20
component_styling.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. bg-transparent border-b border-border/50 focus:border-accent focus:ring-0 rounded-none (for minimalist look) or highly rounded-xl with glass effect.

layouts.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more padding than usual. Sections must have py-24 or py-32.
layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetry over standard Bootstrap columns. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8 to create tension.
layouts.hero: 100vh height. Absolute positioned 3D canvas behind content. Content aligned center or left, massive typography (text-6xl+).
layouts.learning_hub: Netflix/Coursera inspired. Horizontal scrollable carousels for 'Trending', 'Popular', 'Recently Added'. Dense high-fidelity grid for course lists.
layouts.lms_preview: Render as a realistic dashboard inside a mock Macbook/browser window container. Dense grid layout, sharp edges, dark mode forced for this specific section.

animations.text_reveal: Staggered word or character reveal using Framer Motion (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) on scroll.
animations.parallax: Use React Spring Parallax or Framer Motion useScroll. Backgrounds move slower than foreground content.
animations.3d_tilt: Use react-parallax-tilt for course cards and service panels.
animations.cursor: Custom animated framer-motion cursor (blend-mode difference, expands on clickable elements).
animations.background_particles: Use TSParticles with a slow-moving network/orbit preset.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure min 4.5:1 ratio. Text over images must have a gradient overlay or text-shadow.

images.rule: High contrast, dark/moody tech aesthetics. Images inside cards must be masked with rounded corners. Images must never exceed 80vh on mobile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, next-themes (for dark mode toggle), react-tsparticles, react-parallax-tilt, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Configure Next Themes to wrap the application for seamless dark/light mode switching.
Implement the cursor using Framer Motion fixed to the viewport.
Build the Hero component with absolute positioned TSParticles or React Three Fiber background, massive typography.

Create the specific sections requested: About, Services, Learning (Horizontal scrollable courses), LMS Preview (A mock dark dashboard ui), Internships, Technology Orbit (circular spinning tech logos), Why Choose Us, Testimonials, Contact.
DO NOT use generic centered layout. Use the grid system defined above.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
